children: Tenka is an institutional asset-backed finance trading platform that connects asset originators, investors, and liquidity providers. It offers structured bookbuilding, secondary market trading, on-chain settlement, independent valuation, and unified reporting services. According to Odaily, the platform aims to ease liquidity constraints in the private credit market and allow asset-backed financial instruments to be transferred in the secondary market without requiring early borrower repayment or fund-level redemptions. The company said it plans to go live later this year, and its CEO is Emile Dubié.

title: Tenka Plans Institutional Asset-Backed Finance Platform Launch Later This Year
